title: Decision band, map lit
summary: The kit's D1 close for this layer: what the audit's channel orchestration map shows, the readout's four parts with part 02 lit (a door to the full specimen on /reports), the red Request a System Audit with the quiet Talk to the team, and the three layers underneath.
story: The page's one ask, made specific to the RevOps buyer: before anything is built, the audit maps how demand moves across your channels and where it leaks. The SiblingStrip says how this layer relates to the other two: it carries Narrative and is read by Intelligence.

reference.kelwin: The object is this page's: the readout's four parts with part 02 (the channel orchestration map) lit. The same object on all three capability pages, lit on each page's own part, is deliberate: the close is the template's constant, so the reader learns the audit's shape once.
